$comment: Editorial rubric. Judge scores are 0-judgeScale. A page is approved only when verdict=pass AND score >= passThreshold AND no falseClaims remain.

judge.label: Search intent match
judge.guidance: Fully answers what someone searching this title wants: practical questions, steps, conditions, exceptions, decision points. No off-topic padding.

judge.label: On-page SEO
judge.guidance: Title 50-60 chars with keyword front-loaded; description 140-170 chars with keyword in first 120; keyword in first 100 words and at least one H2; descriptive H2s; no keyword stuffing.

judge.label: Structure and readability
judge.guidance: Logical H2/H3 hierarchy without skipped levels; short paragraphs (2-4 sentences); bullet/numbered lists; scannable sections; appropriate length (800-1500 words).

judge.label: Depth and factual accuracy
judge.guidance: Concrete legal detail (durations, conditions, exceptions) that is internally consistent. Specific statute numbers or case-law citations are NOT required and their absence must not be penalized; a correct, general, cautious guide is acceptable. Penalize invented statute numbers, invented case references, or wrong law as falseClaims.

judge.label: E-E-A-T and legal neutrality
judge.guidance: Professional, experience-informed, measured tone. No guaranteed outcomes or outcome promises. Appropriate cautious phrasing and disclaimers where needed.

judge.label: Persuasiveness and CTA
judge.guidance: Guides the reader to a sensible next step (consultation/contact) without pressure and without spammy repetition.

judge.label: Originality
judge.guidance: Concrete, non-generic content. Avoids boilerplate filler and repetitive phrasing.

deterministic.label: Keyword in at least one H2
